completeSupplementValue.name: Ground companion
completeSupplementValue.status: NEW feat-only profile, not a recovered monster record

completeSupplementValue.name: Flying companion
completeSupplementValue.status: NEW feat-only profile, not a recovered monster record

completeSupplementValue.attack: One melee peck/bite, reach5ft, attack=ownerPB+owner actualWIS modifier, damage1d4piercing; no addedWIS damage and no level scaling.

completeSupplementValue.limits: No free Flyby, invisibility, aerial carrying exception, Hover, multiattack or ability to carry a Medium ally. Ordinary falling, weather, carrying and support apply.

completeSupplementValue.name: Swimming companion
completeSupplementValue.status: NEW feat-only profile, not a recovered monster record
completeSupplementValue.eligibleBody: An actual positive-HP living Small Beast with native swimming and biting anatomy. Keep its real breathing requirements; a fish gains no lungs and an air breather gains no gills.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW acquisition: with actual Animal Handling proficiency, select one already real willing/tamed Beast, noncorrupted, INT<7, that fits one of the three finite body templates below. Finding, buying or taming it requires actual campaign access/consent; the feat creates no animal, stocked shop or universal charm. Spend one uninterrupted hour together at touch range; one bond attempt per completedLR, noRP. One feat bond at a time. Use the template corresponding to the real animal's body/native movement; do not turn a dog into a bird or grant a new breathing mode. AC12+floor(ownerPB/2), maximumHP5+total owner level; template attack/ability/movement values are explicit NEW. At initial bond convert existing HP proportionally max(1,floor(newMax×oldHP/oldMax)); preserve actual conditions/injuries. Later maximum growth never heals, decreases clamp without damage. Ordinary legal healing works, but no Hit Dice/rest-refill is invented. Use one shared BA command within60ft while the animal can perceive you: in its attached phase after your regular turn, move and make its one attack or Dash/Disengage/Help/Dodge. No independent turn/Reaction; uncommanded move defensively and Dodge. The animal's HP-only chassis dies at0, producing its one actual corpse and ending the bond, with no Wound/death-save sequence; this is a feat-specific NEW rule, not generic animal law. Death/release never creates replacement: after a new completedLR, a new real animal and full hour are required. Voluntary release takes one uninterrupted hour and ends the bond without healing; preserve the same physical animal and restore its prior ordinary profile with the same current-HP fraction, not a fresh full animal. A creature cannot have this and a Ranger bond simultaneously; transferring requires actual release and new paid acquisition, not additive statistics. Owner death ends the bond and, if the animal remains alive, restores its saved ordinary profile using the same positive-HP ratio conversion as release; a dead animal remains its actual corpse. Temporary owner incapacity prevents new commands but does not cancel a previously committed legal command; after that command, uncommanded phases remain defensive. This never supplies autonomous attacks.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Complete real-animal bond, three body templates, finite statistics, proportional conversion, command/HP-only death and no-free-replacement procedure.
submittedWorkedCases: A ground companion bonded by level5 has max10HP. A real animal at half of its oldHP converts to5HP, not full10.
At0HP it dies and leaves its actual body. Taking a rest alone neither revives it nor creates another beast.
sourceDirection.decision: Adopt the bounded proposal with the completed EX58 controller/phase/physical-history interface; no future transport dependency or extra animal turn.

completeGoverningFeats.operationalRules:
NEW ACQ-05 purchase/bond distinction: acquire Animal Companion once by committing one actual earned unspent feat opportunity while meeting its actual Animal Handling proficiency prerequisite and all other acquisition gates. Record that paid grant and its acquisition snapshot atomically. The animal and bonding hour are not conditions of purchasing the feat. Ownership begins at that commitment, with no companion and one unspent bond attempt under FS-06; it grants neither an animal nor an earlier completed Long Rest. Animal identity, matching template and any actually sourced sense choice belong to each bond record, not a permanently locked feat-purchase choice. The retained nonrepeatability/permanent-choice metadata does not prohibit the replacements expressly allowed here. Canceling a proposed purchase before commitment spends no opportunity. A completed purchase is not refunded or repeated because no animal is available, a bond attempt fails, or a bond later ends. Animal Companion ownership alone can satisfy Companion Training's printed parent alternative, but supplies neither its separate feat opportunity nor a creature on which to use it.

NEW ACQ-05 bond attempt: an owner of this feat with actual Animal Handling proficiency, no current feat bond, no other pending bond attempt, an unspent attempt and any required post-bond-ending Long Rest may select one already real, positive-HP living, willing/tamed, noncorrupted Beast with INT<7 fitting one of the three finite templates. The selected animal must have no incompatible existing bond, including another Animal Companion or Ranger bond. Finding, buying or taming it still needs actual lawful access and its real willing/tamed relationship to this owner; no animal, stocked shop, consent or charm is supplied. Preserve its actual identity, ordinary profile, current/maximum HP, conditions, injuries, native movement, breathing, custody and required template choices. In one ordered start event, recheck admission, reserve this owner and animal for the work, spend the one attempt, and begin the hour. Merely proposing a target or rejecting it before that event does not spend an attempt; it never reverses a previously completed feat purchase. Starting costs no RP, second feat opportunity or universal fee. An attempt cannot begin while an existing feat bond is retained; such a rejected proposal does not release or alter that bond.

Spend one uninterrupted hour of actual bonding work together at touch range. Keep the same owner and animal, actual access, the required proficiency and animal eligibility throughout the work and at completion; the owner must remain able to perform it. This is active work, not beneficial rest, and grants no extra work Watch, assistant shortcut, handover or overlapping incompatible task. Loss of required touch-range access, willing/tamed eligibility, qualifying body state, or the owner's ability to continue, including incapacitation, or voluntary abandonment terminates the attempt. Elapsed time, real losses and the spent attempt persist; no partial hour, resumed fraction or same-epoch retry is awarded. The prospective animal remains in its actual current ordinary state; no feat profile or command entitlement was installed. After a full lawful hour, atomically complete the one bond and apply the existing template/HP conversion to the animal's latest lawful ordinary state, using the owner's then-current governing statistics. No new bond check or success chance is added. Admission alone or an incomplete hour cannot establish a companion.

The initial allowance is one attempt at feat purchase. Each genuinely completed beneficial owner Long Rest thereafter sets the allowance to one, never adds a stored second attempt. Apply FS-06's actual rest limits and one elapsed clock: no reset from Short Rest, debt-only Rest, a repeated rest receipt, a scene, a new target, a new controller, a new day label or level growth. Do not credit active bonding or release work as rest. An invalid claimed completion record is evidence rejection, not an attempt or feat-payment refund: reconcile the real start/interruption/rest history. Missing history cannot be replaced by an assumed unspent allowance. One feat bond at a time. Use the template corresponding to the real animal's body/native movement; do not turn a dog into a bird or grant a new breathing mode. AC12+floor(ownerPB/2), maximumHP5+total owner level; template attack/ability/movement values are explicit NEW. At initial bond convert existing HP proportionally max(1,floor(newMax×oldHP/oldMax)); preserve actual conditions/injuries. Later maximum growth never heals, decreases clamp without damage. Ordinary legal healing works, but no Hit Dice/rest-refill is invented. Use one shared BA command within60ft while the animal can perceive you: in its attached phase after your regular turn, move and make its one attack or Dash/Disengage/Help/Dodge. No independent turn/Reaction; uncommanded move defensively and Dodge. The animal's HP-only chassis dies at0, producing its one actual corpse and ending the bond, with no Wound/death-save sequence; this is a feat-specific NEW rule, not generic animal law. NEW ACQ-05 replacement boundary: when an established feat bond ends through release or death, record that actual ending event. Before this owner begins any later feat bond, require a genuinely beneficial owner Long Rest whose completion is ordered after that event, as well as an available attempt, a real eligible living target and the full new hour. A rest completed before the ending event or an unused prior allowance cannot satisfy that replacement gate. A qualifying completion after the event is sufficient; no additional rule requires the whole rest to have started after it. Existing active-work/rest restrictions still apply. Replacement is a use of the already-owned nonrepeatable feat, not a second purchase. NEW explicit rebond interpretation: a previously released living animal may be selected again if it genuinely qualifies; it is a new bond to the same physical individual, not a new or refreshed animal. A dead animal never becomes eligible merely through rest, release, purchase or this procedure. Voluntary release requires the owner's one uninterrupted hour of actual release work. NEW ACQ-05 release boundary: record its start, but end the bond only on lawful completion; interruption or abandonment grants no partial-hour credit and leaves the existing bond intact unless an independent event already ended it. A fresh release hour may be begun while the bond still exists. Release consumes no bond attempt, feat opportunity or RP. It does not require a second target or borrow the bonding hour's touch-range requirement; actual owner capacity and uninterrupted work remain mandatory. At completion restore the same living animal's saved ordinary profile with the existing positive-current-HP ratio conversion, preserving its current conditions, injuries and actual custody without healing or refilling it. End the outgoing bond's control entitlement and unexecuted commands; preserve all already-spent body/actor allowances. No automatic transfer of custody or command occurs. Record this end for the post-ending Long-Rest gate. A creature cannot simultaneously have this and a Ranger bond, or two owners' Animal Companion bonds. NEW ACQ-05 correction of 'new paid acquisition': a transfer requires the outgoing bond to end through its actual lawful release/death/termination procedure, real lawful access/custody for the receiver, and the receiver's independently authorized new bond. An existing Animal Companion feat owner does not buy that nonrepeatable feat again; they spend their own available attempt and full hour and satisfy their own post-ending Long-Rest gate, if any. The sender's rest, feat ownership or spent attempt neither transfers nor resets the receiver's history. A receiver without this feat must first acquire it through their own actual eligible unspent opportunity, or use an independently acquired receiving engine; receiving the animal grants no feat or class feature. An actual Ranger Beast Companion route retains its own acquired Warder/class-level/selection gates, eligible-beast limits, 4 RP, one-hour touch procedure, once-per-beneficial-owner-Long-Rest allowance and native profile/lifecycle. This feat's no-RP route, release hour and attempt rules do not waive or redefine that class engine. A Ranger bond cannot be ended by invoking another engine's feat-release permission. No universal transfer payment, new animal, healing, additive chassis, second controller, extra phase or refunded body/resource budget is granted. Owner death ends the bond and, if the animal remains alive, restores its saved ordinary profile using the same positive-HP ratio conversion as release; a dead animal remains its actual corpse. Temporary owner incapacity prevents new commands but does not cancel a previously committed legal command; after that command, uncommanded phases remain defensive. This never supplies autonomous attacks.
NEW explicit EX58 interface: retain one real creature identity and one current control/phase record. Riding, bonding or transferring custody does not clone a turn, movement budget, Reaction, attack allowance, body or resource pool. An attached companion acts in its source-defined phase after the owner’s regular turn; a controlled mount uses EX58’s actual mounted-phase procedure. A body fitting both roles elects one compatible route before that round’s work, preserves all already-spent allowances and cannot switch routes to gain a second phase. Its actual load, tack, rider geometry, mounting/dismounting cost and ordinary independent temperament remain. One shared Bonus Action command and one offensive companion action per owner per numbered round apply where those source engines impose them. This feat supplies no blanket override of a specific engine’s attack or no-resource restrictions.
The three supplied body templates are NEW complete feat chassis, not evidence that such a Beast is available. Use only the corresponding real body/native mode. Saved ordinary maximum/currentHP and original constituent identity are required before bonding; no missing oldHP record is replaced by invented full health. The feat’s0HP-death rule applies only to this feat chassis; an independently governed mount/Ranger chassis retains its own rules rather than taking both.

At0HP it dies and leaves its actual body. Taking a rest alone neither revives it nor creates another beast.

completeSupplementValue.name: Measured Strike
completeSupplementValue.activation: Within one actual weapon attack, before its attack roll
completeSupplementValue.procedure: Roll the spentd6 and add it to that one attack roll. Choose before seeing the d20/outcome; natural1 still misses and no extra critical range is created. It adds no damage and supplies no attack, target permission or extra Action.
completeSupplementValue.basis: NEW attack-check enhancement; not an imported Battle Master maneuver.

completeSupplementValue.name: Driving Shove
completeSupplementValue.activation: Replace one Attack Action attack with ordinary Shove
completeSupplementValue.cost: One superiorityd6 plus the replaced attack
completeSupplementValue.procedure: Before both opposed rolls, spend/roll thed6 and add it to yourSTR Athletics total for that one ordinary Shove. Target choosesAthletics/Acrobatics; tie preserves state. Actual reach/one-size-larger cap applies; success still pushes5ft away OR Prone, never both solely from this maneuver. It adds no damage.
completeSupplementValue.basis: NEW finite bonus on reviewed ordinary Shove; printed feat/class save-based Shoves are not this maneuver.

completeSupplementValue.name: Disarming Feint
completeSupplementValue.activation: Replace one Attack Action attack with ordinary opposed Disarm
completeSupplementValue.procedure: Choose a reachable actually held droppable item and an ordinary legal Athletics or weapon-check Disarm. Before rolls, spend/roll thed6 and add it to your one opposed total; defender usesAthletics/Acrobatics, tie preserves state. Success uses the existing adjacent/own-space drop placement, not automatic custody. No damage, severed bond or proficiency grant. The save-based Disarm feat and Whip Control are separate procedures and do not acquire this bonus.
completeSupplementValue.basis: NEW finite die on reviewed ordinary Disarm only.

completeSupplementValue.name: Guarding Deflection
completeSupplementValue.activation: Reaction when one direct damage event would damage you
completeSupplementValue.cost: One superiorityd6 and the actual Reaction
completeSupplementValue.procedure: After passive defenses but before tempHP, spend/roll1d6 to reduce that whole resolved event by its face, minimum0. Allocate across stable native component order. Attached conditions remain. No re-mitigation of transfer packets that forbid recipient mitigation, HP sacrifice, state assignment or direct death. It neither changes a hit to a miss nor qualifies as Riposte's successful Parry.
completeSupplementValue.basis: NEW finite physical defense using current whole-event/damage-provenance interface.

completeSupplementValue.name: Measured Advance
completeSupplementValue.activation: Bonus Action on your own regular turn
completeSupplementValue.cost: One superiorityd6 and the actual BA
completeSupplementValue.procedure: Spend/roll1d6, gaining a separate movement-cost budget of5×face feet resolved immediately. Use one already available movement mode with nonzeroSpeed, pay normal terrain/crawl/squeeze costs, respect legal endpoints and provoke ordinary opportunity attacks. No teleport, new movement mode, free Disengage, replenished ordinary movement or banked distance. Interrupted unspent distance is lost.
completeSupplementValue.basis: NEW bounded movement procedure; no copied Soldier grant.

originalSourceObject.name: Greater Spell Focus
originalSourceObject.description: Your spells are harder to resist.
originalSourceObject.effect: The DC for your spells increases by an additional +1.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure:
The source’s exact “Spell Focus feat” prerequisite is missing from the335-entry registry. Preserve that fact; Mystic Focus, Spell Penetration and school-focus feats are not aliases. NEW proposed complete dependency is the separately defined supplementary Spell Focus feat in this manuscript: one chosen actual spell school, personal spellcasting prerequisite, and+1to saving-throw DCs of your spells cast through that school. It costs its own legal feat selection and has no implicit free acquisition. If GPT rejects or replaces this proposed additional feat, Greater Spell Focus remains dependent on an actual accepted resolution; a similar name alone cannot qualify.

After genuinely acquiring that proposed base feat, Greater Spell Focus adds a further+1to the same chosen school’s actual spell saving-throw DCs, for+2total from this pair. NEW “additional” extends the base’s school scope rather than secretly granting the missing first+1to all spells. The bonuses apply to actual initial and later spell saves using that cast’s snapshotted DC, not spell attack rolls, concentration saves you make, a class-technique DC or a flat printed independent itemDC. Distinct source DC modifiers combine only as their actual families permit. Neither feat is repeatable and the school cannot be freely retargeted. The supplementary record is not inserted into the source335or a public operational manifest by this proposal.

completeGoverningFeats.name: Telepathic

sourceObject.name: Telepathic
sourceObject.description: You can reach out to others with your mind.
sourceObject.effect: You can communicate telepathically with creatures and cast detect thoughts once per long rest.

completeGoverningFeats.originalQuestion: No exact Detect Thoughts definition was found in the848 ordinary plus10 ancestry catalogs. Define telepathy range, willing/aware recipients, senses/languages, directionality and actions; separately resolve once-per-Long-Rest spell grant and actual dependency. Do not invent mind-reading content, a spell profile or creature cognition taxonomy from the feat name.

sourceDirection.name: Telepathic
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: No exact Detect Thoughts definition was found in the848 ordinary plus10 ancestry catalogs. Define telepathy range, willing/aware recipients, senses/languages, directionality and actions; separately resolve once-per-Long-Rest spell grant and actual dependency. Do not invent mind-reading content, a spell profile or creature cognition taxonomy from the feat name.

originalSourceObject.name: Telepathic
originalSourceObject.description: You can reach out to others with your mind.
originalSourceObject.effect: You can communicate telepathically with creatures and cast detect thoughts once per long rest.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure:
Choose INT,WIS orCHA permanently as this feat’s casting ability. NEW communication procedure: while conscious, you may direct one brief intentional message at a time to one perceived willing conscious creature within60feet and line of effect, with the same ordinary conversational timing as speech and no extra Action. A willing recipient may reply through that same temporary channel while eligibility continues. Shared language permits normal phrases; absent a shared language, only a simple voluntarily conveyed image,emotion or basic idea is received, not automatic precise translation. The recipient may refuse or end the exchange; silence supplies no diagnosis of presence,thought,consent or mind protection. This grants no reading,compulsion,command authority,remote tracking,hidden-creature search or ability to use telepathy as a spell’s Vcomponent. Loss of range,line or consciousness ends the channel. It supplies no simultaneous group channel or extra reaction-time instructions beyond actual turn rules.

The named Detect Thoughts has no exact entry in the848ordinary plus10supplemental ancestry source catalogs. NEW proposed feat-only spell payload, explicitly not an alias for Read Surface Thoughts: rank2Divination,Action,V/S/F,one perceived creature within30feet and line of effect,concentration up to1minute. The feat gives one cast per beneficial Long Rest through the common charge route. At initial resolution and on a later Action spent on this one same target while it remains in range/line, request one sample and make a fresh targetWISsave against the featDC. A failed save reveals one actual current conscious surface thought under the already reviewed Read Surface Thoughts information limits; success reveals none. The initial cast Action includes at most one sample. No new sample occurs without its real Action, and repeated sampling does not recast or replay Dissonance. NEW the target becomes aware of an attempted mental intrusion at the first sample, regardless of its save, without automatically identifying a hidden caster.

An absent conscious thought,protection or failed information access supplies no reason-diagnosis; ordinary dreams are not conscious thoughts without a specific exception. Preserve verbal thoughts’ actual language and nonverbal impressions without inventing meaning. There is no memory search,truth enforcement,forced subject,biography,creature-type cognition assumption or automatic translation. Specific information protections,including actual Divination/Scrying protection,apply. No target switch within the one cast; loss of its range/line prevents sampling while the original deadline continues, and ending concentration ends the attempt. The new supplemental profile must be accepted/replaced by GPT before any use; it does not add ordinary class access or silently claim a missing original definition was recovered.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Finite consensual two-way communication; NEW isolated Detect Thoughts recurring surface-sample profile with actual saves,Actions,notification and information protections.
submittedWorkedCases: Two willing creatures sharing no language can exchange a simple image of an open door through the channel; this does not translate an unknown legal contract or read unspoken motives.

A legal Detect Thoughts cast is followed by two later sampling Actions. The target makes three distinct saves total; only actual failed samples expose the thought currently present then, and none compels it to think about the caster’s preferred question.

completeGoverningFeats.originalQuestion: Define eligible learned/recorded rituals, actual ritual tags, access/preparation/components, Intelligence-or-Wisdom13, base casting time plus10minutes and interruption/concentration. Bind no-recovery wording to RP precisely, preserving typo in source. Quick Ritualist/Ritual Channeler are pending counterparts, not approved multipliers or free formula access.

originalSourceObject.effect: You can cast spells with the ritual tag without expending ranked-spell recoverys, but it takes 10 minutes longer.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure:
Keep INT13orWIS13; choose one qualifying ability permanently as this feat’s casting ability. The current848ordinary-card scan finds no explicit Ritual tag in their preserved Core-source tag arrays; neither a familiar external spell name nor a class procedure called ritual proves such a tag. NEW proposed Ritual-tag overlay below explicitly supplies seven existing reviewed rank1payload placements: Detect Magic,Identify,Comprehend Languages,Alarm,Unseen Servant,Find Familiar andIllusory Script, each using its exact Wizard source placement solely to fix rank/school/effect provenance. This new tag is a separate candidate overlay and needs joint approval, including its effect on the actual Wizard Ritual Casting feature. It changes neither those spell effects nor their ordinary class membership.

NEW feat learning route: with an actual complete legitimate formula/text or a willing qualified teacher who genuinely knows the exact ritual, spend8active hours per rank and10gp per rank of real practice/writing materials to record it in your actual usable ritual book. Rank0, if ever separately admitted, uses one rank for this learning cost. A suitable blank book, ink/tools, language access and actual instructor/facility costs remain real. Study uses completed15-minute phases under the language/research clock; it is spell learning/copying, not ordinary research for Diligent Researcher’s discount. There is no random completion roll, free formula, duplicate-learning benefit or tradeXP. The feat grants no free starting ritual or physical book. Its maximum recorded/cast ritual rank is min(9,floor((total character level+1)/2)); this explicit feat-only gate grants no class advancement. The present proposed tag set has only rank1entries, and future entries need their own exact review.

To cast a legitimately learned recorded ritual, use its actual book and all components, spend its ordinary casting time plus ten actual minutes of uninterrupted active casting, and meet its complete targets/action-trigger rules. This route cannot complete during an encounter; interruption ends the attempt with real time and committed consumables spent. NEW maintain concentration during the long casting procedure, ending incompatible prior concentration at commitment; at resolution continue only the resulting spell’s own concentration if any. Do not choose a Reaction-triggered spell and manufacture its trigger through slow preparation. Ordinary rankRPprice and price-only surcharge are0; an expressly printed consumedRPconversion or other independent cost still applies and needs an actual pool. No ordinary Dissonance generation or vent, no Refrain addition/reset or history alteration, and no resource recovery from merely completing the casting time; a spell’s explicitly bounded actual effect remains its own effect. This follows the intended ordinary ritual separation rather than creating an at-will strain reset. Actual Counterspell eligibility, one-attempt-per-pending-cast guards, components and range apply. Source-specific per-rest limits remain. Other pending ritual feats cannot reduce this time or multiply output until their own interactions are decided.

COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-02 — owner-directed preparation-round-only successor for the seven FS-08/SUP-07 feat-copy profiles used through Arcane Adaptation, Eldritch Echo and Mimicry. This supersedes COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-01's both-touched-round policy only. All earlier archives and receipts retain their exact historical wording. This selection changes no profile payload, acquisition predicate, ordinary Ready rule, ordinary class casting cadence or unrelated Mirrorsage class Echo procedure.

PREPARATION. The shared feat-copy cap counts new paid feat-copy casting commitments: a direct cast commits in its current numbered round; a Readied feat copy commits in its preparation numbered round. Require and atomically spend that round's owner feat-copy allowance. If the owner actually has the separately acquired Mirrorsage shared-release engine to which the exact source binds this feat copy, also require and spend that same preparation round's actual shared class allowance. A qualifying ability route alone never creates that engine. Validate the actual setup prerequisites first. At legal preparation commitment, pay the Action, current quote and other actual costs, consume the applicable permission/use once, provide components, record the independent feat-copy family/Dissonance/Refrain once, and establish the one Ready concentration burden before its single preparation counter window. No partial class/feat/resource debit is allowed. Countering, abandonment, replacement, expiry or concentration loss after commitment never refunds those preparation spends, recreates a capture, restores displaced concentration or reopens that round's allowance. Failed precommit validation spends nothing and cannot delete an existing valid hold.

HELD RECORD. Bind one unique preparation ID and actual owner to its fixed captured source/profile/q/mode, preparation-bound choices, paid transaction, consumed permission receipt, preparation round and actual ledger identities. Preserve its original Ready deadline and every independently applicable earlier source/capture/use deadline. Consuming the capture permission at preparation is not itself loss of this paid hold's authorization, but the hold cannot extend the original permission window. No future round's allowance is reserved. The hold remains subject to ordinary concentration, body/source availability and valid replacement rules. Paid preparation alone creates no payload. Earlier prose calling the limit one-copy-release per round is controlled here: it limits new direct casts and Ready preparations, not a later completion of this same paid hold.

RELEASE. After an actual perceivable trigger has completed and before every governing deadline, validate the actual hold and its preparation receipts, the available lawful Reaction, continuing concentration and the release predicates at the points required by their actual sources. Select legal current targets/ordered recipients/area/destination at release under the fixed preparation profile and mode; do not freeze a setup-time ghost target or rewrite preparation-bound choices from hidden results. Neither same-round nor later-round release checks, reserves or spends a new feat-copy allowance or a new Mirrorsage shared-release allowance. The preparation receipts remain spent in their original round. An otherwise lawful delayed release therefore remains eligible even when the release round's feat allowance, an actually owned class shared allowance, or both have already been spent by another lawful use. This exemption belongs only to completion of that specific paid feat-copy hold; it does not waive any new direct cast's or unrelated class Echo's own allowances.

A declined trigger or an invalid precommit release, including no actual Reaction, invalid target/geometry, missing source predicate or uncompleted/unperceived trigger, spends no Reaction, makes no new debit and grants no hidden diagnostic. Keep the existing hold only while its actual concentration and original deadlines permit; another genuine trigger occurrence may be considered. An already-spent release-round copy allowance alone is NOT a failed-release reason. At an exact governing expiry, expiry wins. Lost concentration, actual abandonment, successful replacement or another real ending terminates the hold without a refund; a failed release cannot restore a hold that ended.

On a valid release commitment, atomically consume this hold once and spend the real Reaction before resolving its one payload. No second RP/material payment, capture-use consumption, casting-family/Refrain update, cast hook or Counterspell window occurs. Subsequent prevention or a failed attack/save outcome does not refund the Reaction or preparation; actual source-specific hidden-eligibility checks retain their own paid timing. Duplicate callbacks/retry IDs cannot create a second payload or debit. Immediate Strike/Burst/Mend/Step end the held concentration after resolution. Ward/Hindrance/Boon continue the same one burden under their actual effect clock and earlier limits, never a second concentration slot.

OTHER USES AND PERSISTENCE. Another copy in the release round still needs its own genuinely available Action/source permission, current legal resources/credentials, its own new-commitment allowances and all ordinary concentration/cadence predicates. No Action, Reaction refresh, capture or second concentration slot is granted. A concentration-breaking new cast can end the old hold even though its allowance is irrelevant to the old release. Releasing a prior hold first leaves a genuinely free current-round allowance available for a separate lawful new commitment; a lawful prior current-round use does not by itself block the old hold's release. Actual competing-use opportunities before the owner's next regular START are illustrative prerequisites unless supplied by a real source; the old Ready cannot be carried past that START merely to obtain the ordinary Action. Save/load, extra turns, changing routes/profiles or round labels must preserve owner/hold identity, original expiry, actual consumed receipts, completed release identity and chronological/per-round ledgers. Release never rewrites a later cast's history. This rule is a proposed authoring successor, not implementation of scheduling, live perception, source-qualified recipient effects, canonical persistence or the game engine.

completeSupplementValue.castFamilyKeyContract: NEW feat-copy chronological identity. Every paid feat-copy cast records `castFamilyKey = feat-copy::<canonicalSourceEffectId>`. `canonicalSourceEffectId` is the stable identity of the actually witnessed underlying spell/effect from which the bounded profile was captured; for a source-qualified monster ability use that ability's stable source identity. Changing the capture event, owner, Eldritch Echo/Mimicry/Arcane Adaptation permission, bounded profile, selected damage/type component, q, or qualifying casting-ability route does not create a new family. Copies sharing that key use the ordinary chronological Refrain history together. An ordinary cast of the underlying spell uses its ordinary spell family and does not share the feat-copy family; Mirrorsage Echo Release likewise keeps its own class family. A missing stable underlying source identity is ineligible for release rather than being assigned a favorable new key. This key grants no ordinary spell knowledge or access.
completeSupplementValue.concentrationRules: NEW feat-copy concentration tags. Strike: no. Burst: no. Mend: no. Ward: yes. Hindrance: yes. Boon: yes. Step: no; its movement/teleport resolves instantaneously. A concentration-required copy establishes the releaser's one concentration burden during casting commitment under the ordinary sequence, ending an incompatible existing concentration before the counter window. If that cast is later countered, prior concentration remains ended and no copied lasting effect remains. Loss of concentration ends the Ward/Hindrance/Boon copied effect immediately; their printed earlier deadlines still cap duration. Immediate profiles establish no new concentration burden. Ready is separate: preparation already occupies concentration. On release, an immediate profile resolves and that Ready concentration ends with the released spell; a concentration-required Ward/Hindrance/Boon continues on that same one concentration burden, never a second slot. No witnessed original concentration tag is inherited or used to change these seven profile tags.
completeSupplementValue.strainEngineRules: COPY-ROUTE STRAIN SCOPE. A paid feat-copy cast under FS-08 is an independent feat-casting route for strain purposes. Use FS-09 exactly: base Dissonance 0 for q/rank 0, 1 for ranks 1-5, and 2 for ranks 6-9; apply ordinary same-family Refrain using CRS-01; and use `Limit = max(4, 2*PB + casting modifier)` for that copy route, including its existing surcharge/block thresholds. The owned route chosen to qualify the copy supplies only the permitted casting ability, rank ceiling and other expressly required source credentials; it does not import that class engine's protected Dissonance reduction, routing, vent, prepared-matrix treatment or proc chain into the feat-copy cast. In particular a Wizard-qualified copy is not a prepared matrix, a Shaman-qualified copy is not an ordinary Shaman spell for the totem vent, and a Mirrorsage-qualified copy is not class Echo Release. The ordinary `max(4, 2 + PB + max(0, modifier))` Limit in SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES remains controlling for ordinary class spells within its existing scope and is not globally changed here. If the only qualifying route is the feat-only Eldritch Blast grant, it supplies CHA and only its actual rank-0 ceiling; it does not change the copy engine or Limit, create a Warlock/class engine, or qualify a ranked q>0 copy.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: After an actual successful legal reflection or capture of a spell/supernatural effect through a separately owned source, gain resistance to the one real damage type expressed by its selected copied/reflected component until your next future regular end. NEW choose one observed type for a mixed packet; nondamaging effects grant no damage resistance. It begins after capture/redirect, does not retroactively mitigate earlier damage, and grants no copying permission by itself. Once SR/LR at that event, also mark the one legal captured profile as temporarily known through your second future regular start. During that interval you may activate that exact bounded profile using its actual action, RP, components, rank ceiling and concentration, even if its original one-use record was consumed; no other original spell/monster ability is learned. Each activation is a copy retaining the original no-proc/no-copy/resource flags and the shared one-copy-release/round cap below. Existing Mirrorsage records retain their actual release costs/caps and printed bounded profile. No restoration of archive slots or legacy boss power. Expiry removes permission but not legitimately established effects before their own deadlines.

FEAT335-COPY-RELEASE-SOURCE-01-ADDENDUM — controlling release completion.
NEW feat-copy chronological identity. Every paid feat-copy cast records `castFamilyKey = feat-copy::<canonicalSourceEffectId>`. `canonicalSourceEffectId` is the stable identity of the actually witnessed underlying spell/effect from which the bounded profile was captured; for a source-qualified monster ability use that ability's stable source identity. Changing the capture event, owner, Eldritch Echo/Mimicry/Arcane Adaptation permission, bounded profile, selected damage/type component, q, or qualifying casting-ability route does not create a new family. Copies sharing that key use the ordinary chronological Refrain history together. An ordinary cast of the underlying spell uses its ordinary spell family and does not share the feat-copy family; Mirrorsage Echo Release likewise keeps its own class family. A missing stable underlying source identity is ineligible for release rather than being assigned a favorable new key. This key grants no ordinary spell knowledge or access.

NEW feat-copy concentration tags. Strike: no. Burst: no. Mend: no. Ward: yes. Hindrance: yes. Boon: yes. Step: no; its movement/teleport resolves instantaneously. A concentration-required copy establishes the releaser's one concentration burden during casting commitment under the ordinary sequence, ending an incompatible existing concentration before the counter window. If that cast is later countered, prior concentration remains ended and no copied lasting effect remains. Loss of concentration ends the Ward/Hindrance/Boon copied effect immediately; their printed earlier deadlines still cap duration. Immediate profiles establish no new concentration burden. Ready is separate: preparation already occupies concentration. On release, an immediate profile resolves and that Ready concentration ends with the released spell; a concentration-required Ward/Hindrance/Boon continues on that same one concentration burden, never a second slot. No witnessed original concentration tag is inherited or used to change these seven profile tags.

COPY-ROUTE STRAIN SCOPE. A paid feat-copy cast under FS-08 is an independent feat-casting route for strain purposes. Use FS-09 exactly: base Dissonance 0 for q/rank 0, 1 for ranks 1-5, and 2 for ranks 6-9; apply ordinary same-family Refrain using CRS-01; and use `Limit = max(4, 2*PB + casting modifier)` for that copy route, including its existing surcharge/block thresholds. The owned route chosen to qualify the copy supplies only the permitted casting ability, rank ceiling and other expressly required source credentials; it does not import that class engine's protected Dissonance reduction, routing, vent, prepared-matrix treatment or proc chain into the feat-copy cast. In particular a Wizard-qualified copy is not a prepared matrix, a Shaman-qualified copy is not an ordinary Shaman spell for the totem vent, and a Mirrorsage-qualified copy is not class Echo Release. The ordinary `max(4, 2 + PB + max(0, modifier))` Limit in SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES remains controlling for ordinary class spells within its existing scope and is not globally changed here. If the only qualifying route is the feat-only Eldritch Blast grant, it supplies CHA and only its actual rank-0 ceiling; it does not change the copy engine or Limit, create a Warlock/class engine, or qualify a ranked q>0 copy.

COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-02 — owner-directed preparation-round-only successor for the seven FS-08/SUP-07 feat-copy profiles used through Arcane Adaptation, Eldritch Echo and Mimicry. This supersedes COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-01's both-touched-round policy only. All earlier archives and receipts retain their exact historical wording. This selection changes no profile payload, acquisition predicate, ordinary Ready rule, ordinary class casting cadence or unrelated Mirrorsage class Echo procedure.

PREPARATION. The shared feat-copy cap counts new paid feat-copy casting commitments: a direct cast commits in its current numbered round; a Readied feat copy commits in its preparation numbered round. Require and atomically spend that round's owner feat-copy allowance. If the owner actually has the separately acquired Mirrorsage shared-release engine to which the exact source binds this feat copy, also require and spend that same preparation round's actual shared class allowance. A qualifying ability route alone never creates that engine. Validate the actual setup prerequisites first. At legal preparation commitment, pay the Action, current quote and other actual costs, consume the applicable permission/use once, provide components, record the independent feat-copy family/Dissonance/Refrain once, and establish the one Ready concentration burden before its single preparation counter window. No partial class/feat/resource debit is allowed. Countering, abandonment, replacement, expiry or concentration loss after commitment never refunds those preparation spends, recreates a capture, restores displaced concentration or reopens that round's allowance. Failed precommit validation spends nothing and cannot delete an existing valid hold.

HELD RECORD. Bind one unique preparation ID and actual owner to its fixed captured source/profile/q/mode, preparation-bound choices, paid transaction, consumed permission receipt, preparation round and actual ledger identities. Preserve its original Ready deadline and every independently applicable earlier source/capture/use deadline. Consuming the capture permission at preparation is not itself loss of this paid hold's authorization, but the hold cannot extend the original permission window. No future round's allowance is reserved. The hold remains subject to ordinary concentration, body/source availability and valid replacement rules. Paid preparation alone creates no payload. Earlier prose calling the limit one-copy-release per round is controlled here: it limits new direct casts and Ready preparations, not a later completion of this same paid hold.

RELEASE. After an actual perceivable trigger has completed and before every governing deadline, validate the actual hold and its preparation receipts, the available lawful Reaction, continuing concentration and the release predicates at the points required by their actual sources. Select legal current targets/ordered recipients/area/destination at release under the fixed preparation profile and mode; do not freeze a setup-time ghost target or rewrite preparation-bound choices from hidden results. Neither same-round nor later-round release checks, reserves or spends a new feat-copy allowance or a new Mirrorsage shared-release allowance. The preparation receipts remain spent in their original round. An otherwise lawful delayed release therefore remains eligible even when the release round's feat allowance, an actually owned class shared allowance, or both have already been spent by another lawful use. This exemption belongs only to completion of that specific paid feat-copy hold; it does not waive any new direct cast's or unrelated class Echo's own allowances.

A declined trigger or an invalid precommit release, including no actual Reaction, invalid target/geometry, missing source predicate or uncompleted/unperceived trigger, spends no Reaction, makes no new debit and grants no hidden diagnostic. Keep the existing hold only while its actual concentration and original deadlines permit; another genuine trigger occurrence may be considered. An already-spent release-round copy allowance alone is NOT a failed-release reason. At an exact governing expiry, expiry wins. Lost concentration, actual abandonment, successful replacement or another real ending terminates the hold without a refund; a failed release cannot restore a hold that ended.

On a valid release commitment, atomically consume this hold once and spend the real Reaction before resolving its one payload. No second RP/material payment, capture-use consumption, casting-family/Refrain update, cast hook or Counterspell window occurs. Subsequent prevention or a failed attack/save outcome does not refund the Reaction or preparation; actual source-specific hidden-eligibility checks retain their own paid timing. Duplicate callbacks/retry IDs cannot create a second payload or debit. Immediate Strike/Burst/Mend/Step end the held concentration after resolution. Ward/Hindrance/Boon continue the same one burden under their actual effect clock and earlier limits, never a second concentration slot.

OTHER USES AND PERSISTENCE. Another copy in the release round still needs its own genuinely available Action/source permission, current legal resources/credentials, its own new-commitment allowances and all ordinary concentration/cadence predicates. No Action, Reaction refresh, capture or second concentration slot is granted. A concentration-breaking new cast can end the old hold even though its allowance is irrelevant to the old release. Releasing a prior hold first leaves a genuinely free current-round allowance available for a separate lawful new commitment; a lawful prior current-round use does not by itself block the old hold's release. Actual competing-use opportunities before the owner's next regular START are illustrative prerequisites unless supplied by a real source; the old Ready cannot be carried past that START merely to obtain the ordinary Action. Save/load, extra turns, changing routes/profiles or round labels must preserve owner/hold identity, original expiry, actual consumed receipts, completed release identity and chronological/per-round ledgers. Release never rewrites a later cast's history. This rule is a proposed authoring successor, not implementation of scheduling, live perception, source-qualified recipient effects, canonical persistence or the game engine.

NEW feat-copy chronological identity. Copies sharing that key use the ordinary chronological Refrain history together. An ordinary cast of the underlying spell uses its ordinary spell family and does not share the feat-copy family; Mirrorsage Echo Release likewise keeps its own class family. A missing stable underlying source identity is ineligible for release rather than being assigned a favorable new key. This key grants no ordinary spell knowledge or access.

NEW feat-copy concentration tags. Strike: no. Burst: no. Mend: no. Ward: yes. Hindrance: yes. Boon: yes. Step: no; its movement/teleport resolves instantaneously. PREPARATION. The shared feat-copy cap counts new paid feat-copy casting commitments: a direct cast commits in its current numbered round; a Readied feat copy commits in its preparation numbered round. Require and atomically spend that round's owner feat-copy allowance. At legal preparation commitment, pay the Action, current quote and other actual costs, consume the applicable permission/use once, provide components, record the independent feat-copy family/Dissonance/Refrain once, and establish the one Ready concentration burden before its single preparation counter window. No partial class/feat/resource debit is allowed. Countering, abandonment, replacement, expiry or concentration loss after commitment never refunds those preparation spends, recreates a capture, restores displaced concentration or reopens that round's allowance. Failed precommit validation spends nothing and cannot delete an existing valid hold.

HELD RECORD. Bind one unique preparation ID and actual owner to its fixed captured source/profile/q/mode, preparation-bound choices, paid transaction, consumed permission receipt, preparation round and actual ledger identities. Preserve its original Ready deadline and every independently applicable earlier source/capture/use deadline. Consuming the capture permission at preparation is not itself loss of this paid hold's authorization, but the hold cannot extend the original permission window. No future round's allowance is reserved. The hold remains subject to ordinary concentration, body/source availability and valid replacement rules. Paid preparation alone creates no payload. Earlier prose calling the limit one-copy-release per round is controlled here: it limits new direct casts and Ready preparations, not a later completion of this same paid hold.

RELEASE. After an actual perceivable trigger has completed and before every governing deadline, validate the actual hold and its preparation receipts, the available lawful Reaction, continuing concentration and the release predicates at the points required by their actual sources. Select legal current targets/ordered recipients/area/destination at release under the fixed preparation profile and mode; do not freeze a setup-time ghost target or rewrite preparation-bound choices from hidden results. Neither same-round nor later-round release checks, reserves or spends a new feat-copy allowance or a new Mirrorsage shared-release allowance. The preparation receipts remain spent in their original round. This exemption belongs only to completion of that specific paid feat-copy hold; it does not waive any new direct cast's or unrelated class Echo's own allowances.

A declined trigger or an invalid precommit release, including no actual Reaction, invalid target/geometry, missing source predicate or uncompleted/unperceived trigger, spends no Reaction, makes no new debit and grants no hidden diagnostic. Keep the existing hold only while its actual concentration and original deadlines permit; another genuine trigger occurrence may be considered. An already-spent release-round copy allowance alone is NOT a failed-release reason. At an exact governing expiry, expiry wins. Lost concentration, actual abandonment, successful replacement or another real ending terminates the hold without a refund; a failed release cannot restore a hold that ended.

On a valid release commitment, atomically consume this hold once and spend the real Reaction before resolving its one payload. No second RP/material payment, capture-use consumption, casting-family/Refrain update, cast hook or Counterspell window occurs. Duplicate callbacks/retry IDs cannot create a second payload or debit. Immediate Strike/Burst/Mend/Step end the held concentration after resolution. Ward/Hindrance/Boon continue the same one burden under their actual effect clock and earlier limits, never a second concentration slot.

Releasing a prior hold first leaves a genuinely free current-round allowance available for a separate lawful new commitment; a lawful prior current-round use does not by itself block the old hold's release. Actual competing-use opportunities before the owner's next regular START are illustrative prerequisites unless supplied by a real source; the old Ready cannot be carried past that START merely to obtain the ordinary Action. Save/load, extra turns, changing routes/profiles or round labels must preserve owner/hold identity, original expiry, actual consumed receipts, completed release identity and chronological/per-round ledgers. On your next future regular turn use anAction, actualRPprice and V/S and any additional actual copied-profile component requirement to release that one profile; otherwise it expires at that turn’s end. It is a copied spell activation with actual Dissonance/Refrain/history and interruption at release, no new proc/capture. No free original full spell, copied casterstatistics or Warlockclass.
NEW classification reconciliation, FS-08: releasing this captured spell is a paid feat-copy cast, using the releaser’s specified ability/PB, actual components, current RP price, rank and ordinary Dissonance/Refrain. It is not a resource-free nonspell release. It grants no ordinary repertoire/class feature or further capture, echo, reflection, external feat amplification, class resource/proc or reward chain. The concrete copy profile and its independent component/range/target/deadline limits still apply. This is deliberately different from Echo Spell/Twin Cast secondary results and from an actual Mirrorsage class Echo Release.

FEAT335-COPY-RELEASE-SOURCE-01-ADDENDUM — controlling release completion.
NEW feat-copy chronological identity. Every paid feat-copy cast records `castFamilyKey = feat-copy::<canonicalSourceEffectId>`. `canonicalSourceEffectId` is the stable identity of the actually witnessed underlying spell/effect from which the bounded profile was captured; for a source-qualified monster ability use that ability's stable source identity. Changing the capture event, owner, Eldritch Echo/Mimicry/Arcane Adaptation permission, bounded profile, selected damage/type component, q, or qualifying casting-ability route does not create a new family. Copies sharing that key use the ordinary chronological Refrain history together. An ordinary cast of the underlying spell uses its ordinary spell family and does not share the feat-copy family; Mirrorsage Echo Release likewise keeps its own class family. A missing stable underlying source identity is ineligible for release rather than being assigned a favorable new key. This key grants no ordinary spell knowledge or access.

NEW feat-copy concentration tags. Strike: no. Burst: no. Mend: no. Ward: yes. Hindrance: yes. Boon: yes. Step: no; its movement/teleport resolves instantaneously. A concentration-required copy establishes the releaser's one concentration burden during casting commitment under the ordinary sequence, ending an incompatible existing concentration before the counter window. If that cast is later countered, prior concentration remains ended and no copied lasting effect remains. Loss of concentration ends the Ward/Hindrance/Boon copied effect immediately; their printed earlier deadlines still cap duration. Immediate profiles establish no new concentration burden. Ready is separate: preparation already occupies concentration. On release, an immediate profile resolves and that Ready concentration ends with the released spell; a concentration-required Ward/Hindrance/Boon continues on that same one concentration burden, never a second slot. No witnessed original concentration tag is inherited or used to change these seven profile tags.

COPY-ROUTE STRAIN SCOPE. A paid feat-copy cast under FS-08 is an independent feat-casting route for strain purposes. Use FS-09 exactly: base Dissonance 0 for q/rank 0, 1 for ranks 1-5, and 2 for ranks 6-9; apply ordinary same-family Refrain using CRS-01; and use `Limit = max(4, 2*PB + casting modifier)` for that copy route, including its existing surcharge/block thresholds. The owned route chosen to qualify the copy supplies only the permitted casting ability, rank ceiling and other expressly required source credentials; it does not import that class engine's protected Dissonance reduction, routing, vent, prepared-matrix treatment or proc chain into the feat-copy cast. In particular a Wizard-qualified copy is not a prepared matrix, a Shaman-qualified copy is not an ordinary Shaman spell for the totem vent, and a Mirrorsage-qualified copy is not class Echo Release. The ordinary `max(4, 2 + PB + max(0, modifier))` Limit in SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES remains controlling for ordinary class spells within its existing scope and is not globally changed here. If the only qualifying route is the feat-only Eldritch Blast grant, it supplies CHA and only its actual rank-0 ceiling; it does not change the copy engine or Limit, create a Warlock/class engine, or qualify a ranked q>0 copy.

COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-02 — owner-directed preparation-round-only successor for the seven FS-08/SUP-07 feat-copy profiles used through Arcane Adaptation, Eldritch Echo and Mimicry. This supersedes COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-01's both-touched-round policy only. All earlier archives and receipts retain their exact historical wording. This selection changes no profile payload, acquisition predicate, ordinary Ready rule, ordinary class casting cadence or unrelated Mirrorsage class Echo procedure.

PREPARATION. The shared feat-copy cap counts new paid feat-copy casting commitments: a direct cast commits in its current numbered round; a Readied feat copy commits in its preparation numbered round. Require and atomically spend that round's owner feat-copy allowance. If the owner actually has the separately acquired Mirrorsage shared-release engine to which the exact source binds this feat copy, also require and spend that same preparation round's actual shared class allowance. A qualifying ability route alone never creates that engine. Validate the actual setup prerequisites first. At legal preparation commitment, pay the Action, current quote and other actual costs, consume the applicable permission/use once, provide components, record the independent feat-copy family/Dissonance/Refrain once, and establish the one Ready concentration burden before its single preparation counter window. No partial class/feat/resource debit is allowed. Countering, abandonment, replacement, expiry or concentration loss after commitment never refunds those preparation spends, recreates a capture, restores displaced concentration or reopens that round's allowance. Failed precommit validation spends nothing and cannot delete an existing valid hold.

HELD RECORD. Bind one unique preparation ID and actual owner to its fixed captured source/profile/q/mode, preparation-bound choices, paid transaction, consumed permission receipt, preparation round and actual ledger identities. Preserve its original Ready deadline and every independently applicable earlier source/capture/use deadline. Consuming the capture permission at preparation is not itself loss of this paid hold's authorization, but the hold cannot extend the original permission window. No future round's allowance is reserved. The hold remains subject to ordinary concentration, body/source availability and valid replacement rules. Paid preparation alone creates no payload. Earlier prose calling the limit one-copy-release per round is controlled here: it limits new direct casts and Ready preparations, not a later completion of this same paid hold.

RELEASE. After an actual perceivable trigger has completed and before every governing deadline, validate the actual hold and its preparation receipts, the available lawful Reaction, continuing concentration and the release predicates at the points required by their actual sources. Select legal current targets/ordered recipients/area/destination at release under the fixed preparation profile and mode; do not freeze a setup-time ghost target or rewrite preparation-bound choices from hidden results. Neither same-round nor later-round release checks, reserves or spends a new feat-copy allowance or a new Mirrorsage shared-release allowance. The preparation receipts remain spent in their original round. An otherwise lawful delayed release therefore remains eligible even when the release round's feat allowance, an actually owned class shared allowance, or both have already been spent by another lawful use. This exemption belongs only to completion of that specific paid feat-copy hold; it does not waive any new direct cast's or unrelated class Echo's own allowances.

A declined trigger or an invalid precommit release, including no actual Reaction, invalid target/geometry, missing source predicate or uncompleted/unperceived trigger, spends no Reaction, makes no new debit and grants no hidden diagnostic. Keep the existing hold only while its actual concentration and original deadlines permit; another genuine trigger occurrence may be considered. An already-spent release-round copy allowance alone is NOT a failed-release reason. At an exact governing expiry, expiry wins. Lost concentration, actual abandonment, successful replacement or another real ending terminates the hold without a refund; a failed release cannot restore a hold that ended.

On a valid release commitment, atomically consume this hold once and spend the real Reaction before resolving its one payload. No second RP/material payment, capture-use consumption, casting-family/Refrain update, cast hook or Counterspell window occurs. Subsequent prevention or a failed attack/save outcome does not refund the Reaction or preparation; actual source-specific hidden-eligibility checks retain their own paid timing. Duplicate callbacks/retry IDs cannot create a second payload or debit. Immediate Strike/Burst/Mend/Step end the held concentration after resolution. Ward/Hindrance/Boon continue the same one burden under their actual effect clock and earlier limits, never a second concentration slot.

OTHER USES AND PERSISTENCE. Another copy in the release round still needs its own genuinely available Action/source permission, current legal resources/credentials, its own new-commitment allowances and all ordinary concentration/cadence predicates. No Action, Reaction refresh, capture or second concentration slot is granted. A concentration-breaking new cast can end the old hold even though its allowance is irrelevant to the old release. Releasing a prior hold first leaves a genuinely free current-round allowance available for a separate lawful new commitment; a lawful prior current-round use does not by itself block the old hold's release. Actual competing-use opportunities before the owner's next regular START are illustrative prerequisites unless supplied by a real source; the old Ready cannot be carried past that START merely to obtain the ordinary Action. Save/load, extra turns, changing routes/profiles or round labels must preserve owner/hold identity, original expiry, actual consumed receipts, completed release identity and chronological/per-round ledgers. Release never rewrites a later cast's history. This rule is a proposed authoring successor, not implementation of scheduling, live perception, source-qualified recipient effects, canonical persistence or the game engine.

completeSupplementValue.size: Tiny, occupies a supported 5 ft square as a low plant; does not block traversal or grant cover; zeroSpeed and no voluntary movement. Can be carried only as an ordinary object-body interaction; lifting/uprooting ends it immediately without harvest.
completeSupplementValue.statistics: Plant creature; no assumed language, mind immunity or world-origin claim. AC 12, HP 5+owner PB snapshotted at creation; saves +owner PB, other checks +0. No damage/condition immunities or special senses unless an actual source grants them. It perceives commands within 60 ft through ordinary sight/hearing; Silence matters for spoken commands. It has no independent initiative, Action, Bonus Action or Reaction, and no attack outside the commanded profiles or the final expressly bounded Trapcasting exception. Zero HP permanently destroys it instead of creating a dying body. No corpse, reward, harvest, resource/soul collection, loot or Supply credit. Ordinary legal damage and healing may affect the actual creature but cannot recreate a destroyed plant, refill its creation entitlement or extend its deadline.
completeSupplementValue.dc: At acquisition select one actual possessed spellcasting route; use DC 8+current PB+that route’s current ability modifier. No phantom Wisdom/Spellcraft statistic. Actual source-specific component/target defenses still apply. FEAT335-FLORA-SOURCE-CHECK-01 / FLQ-01 — KEEP acquisition-only provider selection. A valid paid Conjure Flora acquisition permanently binds its actual qualifying personal casting route and the ability operand supplied by that route. Later loss, expiry, retraining-away or temporary unavailability of that casting grant does not by itself remove Conjure Flora, reselect its provider, prohibit an otherwise legal Flora creation/command/Bloom Burst, terminate an existing seedling or disable an already armed entry trap. Current prepared repertoire, renewable casting charges and RP are not new ongoing Flora prerequisites. This does not qualify a NEW feat acquisition through a grant that is actually gone; ACQ-03 still governs that separate snapshot. Flora is a magical nonspell feat, not a cast through the provider: a spell-only prohibition applies only to its actual scope, Silence still blocks an audible command, and an effect actually suppressing this feat, a plant, its magic or the required action applies under that effect's own rule. NEW explicit lost-provider representation: retain the original provider/ability binding and compute Flora DC as 8 + the owner's current lawful PB + the current modifier of that bound ability; no alternative route, Wisdom default, reconstructed casting entitlement or favorable old ability score is substituted. A missing or invalid original acquisition/provider record is not cured by this rule. Completed results are not recalculated, and existing body HP/save snapshots, deadlines, spent uses and ownership are not reset.
completeSupplementValue.cadence: Action creates; one creation use per beneficial SR/LR under FS-06; current capacity is one plant, or two at total character level 10. FEAT335-FLORA-SOURCE-CHECK-01 / FLQ-02–03 — NEW second-creation window completion. Each legally completed first creation records one original use ID, its first-plant ID and that plant's original minute deadline, with at most one additional creation unspent. This is a bounded open-use record even when the owner is below total level 10; it is not another rest use or an immediately usable creation at that level. Admit a second creation only while that same first plant remains present and unended, before its original deadline, with the additional creation unspent, current total character level at least 10, actual free plant capacity, and every ordinary Action, ground, range, line-of-effect and use predicate satisfied. The level-10 condition is live at the additional Action, not snapshotted at first creation. sourceObject.effect: You can communicate simple ideas to plants within 60 feet and sense coarse emotions from rooted life (fear, hunger, dormancy). sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: While conscious, exchange brief simple ideas with actual plants within 60 ft you perceive and have line of effect to, using ordinary communication; receive only coarse current fear, hunger, dormancy, not language, intelligence, visions, identity records or omniscient history. A plant may be unresponsive; compel nothing. Gain advantage on actual Nature checks in wilderness terrain, with normal work/senses. While at least one Conjure Flora seedling remains active, gain+1 spell attack/DC under the NEW finite Nature predicate: spells actually cast through your Druid, Ranger or Shaman route, excluding copied profiles; no alias from a plant-themed name. Current strongest same-stat bonus applies. In that same active-flora state, difficult terrain caused solely by nonmagical plants costs normal movement; other causes/hazards remain. Once LR spend one uninterrupted minute at a real rooted stand within reach to store a brief message of at most 25 words and one designated known ally identity. For 24 elapsed hours, the first time that ally passes within 10 ft the stand whispers it audibly once and ends the record. Others can hear normally; no remote confirmation or extracted plant memory. Destroying the stand ends the message; no new sentience or cosmology is asserted.

The next actual spell you commit consumes/attaches the record automatically, even if countered or unsuitable; no indefinite skipping. Guidance adds its one 1d4 only to one actual ability/task check made by that next spell, declared before rolling; Resistance adds its one 1d4 only to one actual concentration save maintaining that next spell; True Strike grants advantage only on that next spell’s first actual spell attack. sourceObject.description: The green speaks to you in sap and silence. You answer with growth. Prestige lineage: Verdant Animist. completed from the existing development record.)
sourceObject.effect: You can communicate simple ideas to plants within 60 feet and sense coarse emotions from rooted life (fear, hunger, dormancy). While you have at least one conjured flora active, you gain +1 to spell save DC and attack rolls for nature spells, and difficult terrain from nonmagical plants does not cost you extra movement. You have advantage on Nature checks in wilderness terrain. Once per long rest, you may ask a stand of plants to hold a memory for 24 hours—a whispered name, direction, or warning that replays when an ally you designate passes within 10 feet.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: While conscious, exchange brief simple ideas with actual plants within 60 ft you perceive and have line of effect to, using ordinary communication; receive only coarse current fear, hunger, dormancy, not language, intelligence, visions, identity records or omniscient history. A plant may be unresponsive; compel nothing. Gain advantage on actual Nature checks in wilderness terrain, with normal work/senses. While at least one Conjure Flora seedling remains active, gain+1 spell attack/DC under the NEW finite Nature predicate: spells actually cast through your Druid, Ranger or Shaman route, excluding copied profiles; no alias from a plant-themed name. Current strongest same-stat bonus applies. In that same active-flora state, difficult terrain caused solely by nonmagical plants costs normal movement; other causes/hazards remain. Once LR spend one uninterrupted minute at a real rooted stand within reach to store a brief message of at most 25 words and one designated known ally identity. For 24 elapsed hours, the first time that ally passes within 10 ft the stand whispers it audibly once and ends the record. Others can hear normally; no remote confirmation or extracted plant memory. Destroying the stand ends the message; no new sentience or cosmology is asserted.
