completeSupplementValue.proposedBorrowedProcedure:
KEEP this SUP-09 row's exact source ranger.base.nature-s-whisper, minimum borrower total level 1 and actualSourceClass Ranger. Use only the separately paid Versatile Mastery ability branch, its one-minute preparation within 5 feet, current conscious willing party donor within 30 feet who actually perceives and understands the signal, and its one-use/beneficial-rest and same-card recharge histories. The donor must actually hold the chosen unsuppressed, nonborrowed class grant. No Ranger level, repertoire, skill proficiency, pool or engine is copied. Pay the borrower's own legal Action and 1 actual personal RP plus its feat use at activation commitment; a valid generic Ready substitutes the setup Action and release Reaction as specified below. The donor pays nothing.

The following complete native operating procedure also controls this one borrowed activation; 'you' means the borrower. The native Ranger acquisition schedule is not imposed as a second acquisition gate on this expressly permitted borrowed route. This replaces only this row's former unresolved 'minorWeave/sharedcasting restrictions' wording, not the other eleven SUP-09 procedures:

Gain advantage on one Perception/Survival check to find tracks, hidden natural creatures or signs of passage. It reveals evidence on success, not automatically creatures through total cover, incorporeal beings or thoughts.

NEW NWQ-01 classification: this exact card is a magical nonspell class technique, not an ordinary spell, class spell, cantrip, Echo release or Matrix cast. Preserve spellRank:null and the historical originalText; no rank, school, spell component block, repertoire, spellcasting credential or class engine is inferred from its name, its historical minor-spell wording or its 1 RP cost.

NEW NWQ-02 activation: no verbal, somatic, focus, material, command-word or audible channel is required by the technique itself. You must be conscious, capable of the required Action, legitimately entitled to this exact activation, ready on its own recharge ledger, and able to perceive and have line of effect to the selected actual natural terrain within 15 feet. Silence, occupied hands or lack of a casting focus alone do not prohibit it. Actual suppression or a prohibition whose operative scope covers this magical technique still applies. The later investigation keeps its own senses, hands, tools, access and task requirements. A permitted borrowed activation separately requires Versatile Mastery's actual donor preparation, consent and perceived/understood signal; the technique supplies no communication channel.

KEEP shared technique strain: pay 1 actual RP from your own existing lawful personal pool, not a donor pool or newly granted pool. No ordinary spell-rank price, spell strain surcharge, automatic spell Dissonance, Refrain update, remembered-spell-name change, Fracture ranked-cast prohibition or rank-based trauma is applied by this activation. It does not clear, advance, consume or vent an ordinary spell-cadence record. Do not invent a casting ability or recompute a strain Limit for it. A later Perception or Survival check uses your own current applicable task ability and actual proficiency or replacing Expertise, ordinarily Wisdom, not a donor modifier or automatic borrowed skill proficiency. There is no activation attack or saving-throw DC. Its legal commitment is a magical-ability-use event: it prevents idle-turn Dissonance recovery on the actor's regular turn containing that commitment, including when the paid activation is interrupted. An illegal uncommitted declaration is not such an event. Merely retaining the rider or applying it to a later ordinary task is not another activation. Extra turns and off-turn releases create no additional recovery tick and cannot rewrite a completed tick. Actual separately acquired hooks operate only on their exact triggers; this is not a Bard Performance or an ordinary Ranger spell cast, and it grants no donor Track Target, Hit Chain, stabilization, Crescendo or Echo engine.

NEW NWQ-04 commitment and area: before payment, declare this source, actor and one fixed investigation area consisting only of the actual natural terrain within 15 feet of the actor's commitment position that is then perceivable and has line of effect. Record that area and position; the area does not follow the actor and no moving aura or remote sensor is created. Actual hidden clues need not already be known or present to make an otherwise lawful investigation site eligible. Commit the legal Action and 1 RP together, set the actor's same-card Recharge counter to 3, and, for borrowing, spend the single Versatile Mastery use at that same commitment. Record donor provenance without spending any donor resource. A rejected precommit declaration spends none of these costs. Resolve the activation within that same action after only genuinely applicable source-defined interruptions; there is no automatic Counterspell window, opposed cast roll or concentration test. Ordinary Counterspell and rank-limited spell dispels do not acquire this nonspell target. A separately sourced interrupt or suppression must actually cover it; ordinary damage alone does not add a concentration requirement. If the actor cannot finish the activation or its fixed terrain is no longer legally in range, perceivable and reachable by line of effect at resolution, the paid activation fails without a new area or refund. Borrowing's donor condition is tested at actual activation commitment, not imposed as a new continuing tether after receipt of the signal.

NEW NWQ-04 rider and check: a surviving activation gives this actor one unused rider from actual resolution until resolution time plus 60 elapsed seconds; the exact deadline is not renewed by travel, turns, initiative changes, donor departure or the borrowed permission ending. No concentration is required. At most one unused Nature's Whisper rider belongs to that actor across native and borrowed uses; a new successful resolution replaces an older unused rider, not stacks or banks checks. A failed or interrupted new activation does not itself replace an older otherwise valid rider. Before any dice or outcome are supplied, voluntarily bind the rider to one separately lawful and paid Perception or Survival check about tracks, hidden natural creatures or signs of passage in the original fixed area. The relevant terrain/evidence must still be natural, within 15 feet of the actor and accessible to the task's actual senses and line of effect; no total-cover, thoughts, incorporeal-detection or automatic-revelation exception is supplied. Consume the rider at that check's outcome commitment before rolling or determining its result, even if other advantage already exists, disadvantage cancels it, the legal check fails, or a genuine interruption then prevents its result. An invalid check declaration does not consume the rider or grant a free roll. A paid longer task whose check reaches adjudication at or after the deadline receives no rider. Use ordinary task resolution and advantage cancellation; no passive-score adjustment, extra degree effect, free check, new retry or second bonus is granted. Reveal only real evidence supported by the actual successful task and observer rules; unknown data is not proof of absence. Failure does not reveal otherwise hidden facts. Expired, consumed or ended riders cannot be reclaimed by repeating a request.

KEEP generic nonspell Ready: this Action-time technique may be readied through the current Ready procedure. Ready setup spends its Action and records one perceivable trigger; it does not activate Nature's Whisper, pay its RP/feat use, start its Recharge, start its minute, update spell history or create held-spell concentration. On a legal release before Ready expires, spend the required permitted Reaction and perform the actual activation commitment instead of another Action; recheck its own entitlement, recharge, personal RP, terrain and, for borrowing, the prepared donor/signal conditions at that release. An invalid or declined trigger spends no release resource and may await another valid trigger within the same Ready window. Unreleased, replaced or expired Ready loses its setup Action but not an unspent Nature/feat cost. A legally released then interrupted activation retains all committed costs and Recharge. Native and borrowed copies use the actor's same source-ID recharge history; borrowing does not refresh it or the donor's history. Recharge 3 ticks once at each subsequent owner regular-turn start, or once per six elapsed seconds outside initiative without double counting; extra Actions and extra turns do not tick it. A recharge becoming ready grants no new borrowed feat use.

originalSourceObject.name: Versatile Mastery
originalSourceObject.description: Racial feat tied to Human heritage.
originalSourceObject.effect: Once per rest, use a class skill or ability from another party member.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Require actual Human heritage. NEW once per completed beneficialSR orLR, borrow one permitted class skill for one check OR one class ability activation from a real willing current party member. Before use, spend one uninterrupted minute together within5ft communicating through an actual shared language/channel; choose the exact currently acquired donor skill/card and record donor consent. This preparation changes no resources and does not spend the use; one prepared choice at a time, ending at the next completedrest or replacement. Donor must have it through actual class training/acquisition, not a copied, borrowed or suppressed grant; you must meet actual body/equipment and the menu's total-level gate. You may then consume the feat use on your own legal check/activation while donor is conscious within30ft and can perceive/understand your signal; donor spends noAction, use or resource. A skill choice uses your own ability+normalPB for one real check, replacing lower proficiency, never donor ability, expertise or passive bonus; the task must actually use that donor's class-granted skill. An ability choice uses one of the twelve exact permitted cards/procedures below, your own stats/PB/materials and actual activation cost. These finite NEW borrowing limits deliberately narrow the source's otherwise unbounded class-ability promise for joint decision. No extra feat use after failure, no copied class levels/engines, passive/Arch/Hero/finale ability, transformation, companion, summon, item production, resource generation, permanent learning or further borrowing. The menu grants a one-use ability permission, never its independent class resource pool; actual1RP cost must be paid from your existing personal legalRPpool. Shared spell/Weave restrictions still apply where printed. An already-known same card shares its own recharge/use ledger, so borrowing cannot bypass a spent natural entitlement; an unknown menu card gets only this one borrowed activation and its future recharge history is retained. Existing ordinary resources and restrictions persist after the temporary permission ends. Lasting riders keep their original deadlines and source identity, with you as actor and donor provenance retained.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Consent/minute preparation, one check or exact twelve-card activation, own actual costs, bounded statistics and no permanent/copy/resource engine.
submittedWorkedCases: A willing Soldier teaches Tactical Reposition; the Human spends its ownBA and feat use to move half its ownSpeed along a legal route.
Borrowing Nature's Whisper still costs1realRP. A Human with noRPpool cannot pay and must choose a different legal option before committing.

completeSupplementValue.name: Shaded lamp
completeSupplementValue.procedure: Action light or extinguish the integral enclosed wick. While lit it gives bright light10ft and dim light another10ft for the remaining gadget lifetime. No fuel inventory, attack, ignition of other objects, magical darkness penetration or restored illumination item is created.

completeSupplementValue.name: Line bell
completeSupplementValue.procedure: Action fix the gadget and its attached5ft non-load-bearing thread across one reachable ground passage. An actual body crossing and physically touching the taut thread rings an ordinary bell audible30ft, then the thread releases and the device becomes inert. It neither detects incorporeal/noncontact passage nor reveals identity/location beyond its physical site, restrains, trips or causes damage. A visible thread can be noticed by ordinary senses; it has no automatic hidden DC.

completeSupplementValue.name: Light clamp
completeSupplementValue.procedure: Action attach/remove the clamp to a reachable mundane edge no more than2inches thick. It can hold one unattended or willingly presented object of at most5lb against that edge, falling normally on expiry/destruction. It cannot restrain a creature, secure a door against forced entry, support a climber, substitute for restraints or improve a check. No free hand is created.

completeSupplementValue.name: Hand fan
completeSupplementValue.procedure: Action crank while held to move ordinary air through a5ft cone until the start of your next regular turn; sustained use needs anotherAction. It can cool a touched/hands-reach surface for comfort and stir loose paper/dust, without mechanical damage, creature movement, suffocation relief, weather/hazard immunity or removal of a rules-defined gas/cloud. It can visibly show ordinary airflow but identifies no substance.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Require actual Gnome heritage. NEW once per24 elapsed hours, spend10 uninterrupted minutes with actual usable tinkers tools and5gp of suitable owned mundane parts; commit the use and parts at construction start. The feat grants construction permission with these tools but no general tool proficiency. On completion roll1d4 openly on the four complete profiles below; no choice, reroll, duplicate product or refund for an unwanted result. One active feat gadget at a time; beginning a new legal construction ends the old gadget. Interrupted work loses the committed parts/use and yields no working gadget. The Tiny mundane object is1lb, AC10, HP1, has no creature turn/actions, and stops after1hour from completion or destruction. Place it in a reachable legal space or activate it with the profile's Action; moving/holding uses actual hands/object rules. Ownership can pass with the real object; its expiry/remaining uses travel with it and never reset. At expiry/dismantling it becomes inert spent parts with no reusable credited crafting value; no purchased tool/supply/consumable is replenished. Explicitly NEW economics, not a claim that original source named a price. It does not inherit Tinker Gnome's separate four clockwork profiles,10gp reclaim or maintenance loop, and creates no Tinker class device/attack/companion.

FT84 source-follow-through selection (proposed; the following explicit interaction controls only this named composition):
FT84-Q03 / FT84-CLOSED-CREATION-01 — Craftsman applies to actual authorized creation, not names or all fixed-duration work.
INTERPRETATION SELECTED: personally leading an independently authorized closed feat process that makes/assembles a new usable physical body or prepared kit is eligible creation even when it is non-artisan, lacks a catalog recipe ID or prints a fixed base duration. Craftsman supplies only its half-active-time factor; it supplies no process, skill, formula, assistants, work opportunity, materials, use or output. Use the strongest genuinely applicable creation reduction once. An explicit source exclusion or distinct alteration/preparation/service category still controls. Keep actual physical minimum phases only where the source requires them; do not manufacture an advanced-recipe incorporation phase for every short feat process.
Contraption Crafter's ten minutes are the ordinary base for its real gadget construction. With actual personally leading Craftsman ownership the complete job is five uninterrupted active minutes, not ten with a final five-minute discount and not two-and-a-half from a second equivalent half. The whole adjusted job must be uninterrupted; phase logging, assistant handoff, pauses, rest or partially completed earlier attempts cannot satisfy it. Keep actual Gnome heritage, usable tinker's tools, the same five-gp suitable owned parts and the same once-per-24-elapsed-hours use committed at start. A new lawful construction still ends its old gadget at start. Interruption spends the committed parts/use and yields no working gadget, no completion roll, no refundable tail and no resumable partial product. Completion rolls the same one d4 openly, once; it grants no chosen profile, duplicate gadget, general proficiency, quality, recipe XP or parts recovery. The same one-hour gadget lifetime starts at actual completion, not at the undiscounted hypothetical finish. Transfer/deployment/activation/recharge rules are unchanged. The time benefit is prospective and cannot manufacture a mid-job feat acquisition opportunity; if a real change interrupts the required work, the ordinary failure consequence applies.
Trapsetter's independently authorized thirty-active-minute kit assembly is likewise eligible creation: fifteen active minutes with Craftsman. This includes only its actual prepared-kit assembly from the real source parts; it cannot manufacture an ordinary twenty-caltrop stock bag out of an arbitrary substitute or count buying/deploying one as new creation. Keep the one completion DC12 INT/Engineering or DEX/thieves-tools check, ordinary task degree/natural shifts collapsed to binary, actual parts, failure consumption and recoverable remaining metal/frame. No manufacturing quality/yield/XP or general recipe is added. NEW NARROW WORK-CREDIT COMPLETION for this otherwise unphased kit assembly: track actual active work in seconds against the adjusted required total; pauses do not by themselves erase already completed usable physical assembly work. A pause earns no credit, protection or rest entitlement. Preserve the actual partial body and committed stock under their ordinary custody, deterioration and loss rules; work that a genuine physical event destroys cannot remain credited. The unfinished kit has no function. Resume only the remaining actual work with the real usable/replacement parts; do not duplicate stock, credit or partial bodies. No completion roll occurs until the whole adjusted job is actually complete. Neither Contraption's uninterrupted-work/use forfeiture nor advanced manufacture's incorporation/stabilization is imported. A more-specific explicitly authorized phase/loss rule still controls.
Kit assembly does not spend or refresh Trapsetter's three source-specific quick-placement allowances, arm a trap, clear an old active slot, reset hard-denial history or reduce placement, arming, disarming, collection or trigger/Reaction costs. Those remain separately paid physical events.
Apply the same predicate to Bowyer's actual bounded mundane bow/arrow creation and Master Smithing's authorized weapon/armor creation: their actual creation work qualifies, with full bridge credentials, stock, DC, phases and waits. Combat Engineering's actual barricade creation also qualifies but its own half factor and Craftsman compare once (60 to30, not15). Master Smithing's expressly nondiscounted eight-hour temper and Combat Engineering's expressly fixed ten-minute kill-zone preparation remain unchanged. Separate encoding, repair, maintenance, harvesting, copying, ritual casting and rest remain outside Craftsman. Actual advanced recipe121 still keeps its own required included incorporation/phase/stock/assistant rules; the short feat processes do not rewrite them. Merely printing a fixed duration neither exempts genuine creation nor makes a noncreation activity eligible.

Giving the gadget to an ally passes the same object with its existing deadline; midnight or a rest does not refresh the feat.

commonAnimalRules.profile: AC12+floor(current ownerPB/2); dynamic maximumHP5+current total owner level; all ordinary saves use current ownerPB alone; other ability checks use template ability modifiers, no PB unless a real source grants it. Template INT3 is a feat-profile value, not proof that a real source beast meets the INT<7 admission gate.
commonAnimalRules.nativeBody: Preserve actual original source profile, body identity, current health ratio, size, breathing, conditions, disease, hunger, custody and age. Templates replace only their stated combat/ability/speed values for this bond. Any actual anatomy incapacity/sensory blocker remains. No template creates a supernatural sense, trait, hand or extra body.
commonAnimalRules.actions: One command and offensive allowance across owner companions/devices per numbered round. Commanded body has one attached phase after whole owner regular turn, move plus chosen legal attack or standard Dash/Disengage/Help/Dodge; Dash adds one currentSpeed to its phase cap, Disengage suppresses opportunities for that phase, Help follows actual5ft/physically possible aid and expires at the next original companion-start marker. No independent BA/Reaction/turn/death save; no extra-turn phase. Uncommanded only defensive movement/Dodge.
commonAnimalRules.conversion: Admission requires a real living animal with positiveHP and positive maximumHP and an actual eligible willing/tamed receipt. Initial and release conversion preserves health ratio using max(1,floor(newMax*oldHP/oldMax)), not a heal/damage event. At0 the feat animal is dead, never eligible for conversion. Save the prior source profile rather than deriving a new one on release.
commonAnimalRules.recovery: No resummon, free rest healing, unprinted Hit Dice or new original animal from a saved profile. External legal healing/resurrection retains its actual costs and rules; resurrection returns the same body unbonded, and new bonding still requires the post-death completedLR plus full procedure. Capacity change never repairs injury, replenishes resources or creates death/HP-loss triggers.
